[DX] DREXUN ARENA · PRIVACY

Privacy

What this website shows about players.

What is shown

For everyone who has played on the server: the Steam name they last played with, their SteamID64 (in the address of their player page, with a link to their public Steam profile), rating, level, title, XP, ranked record, kills, deaths and headshots, damage per round, where their hits land, their top weapons, maps and modes, their rating over the season, past season places, the day they joined and the day they last played.

The same numbers are visible in game to everyone through !top, !toplevel and !profile. The live server status lists the names of the players online, like the server browser does.

What is never shown

  • Chat messages, reports, and anything the staff see.
  • IP addresses or locations.

No ads and no trackers. The only cookie is the one that keeps you signed in after "Sign in with Steam": it holds your SteamID, is signed so nobody can fake it, and lasts 30 days or until you sign out. Your Steam password is only ever typed on Steam's own page, never here.
